user.title: Floorplan card companion
user.description: Serves the floor plan card to every dashboard and runs what must work without a tablet: the front door warning, walk reminders and check-offs for all devices, and the live position of the robot vacuum. Everything is set up from the card.

frontend_missing.title: Floor plan card: card file missing
frontend_missing.description:
The companion integration is set up, but the card's file (`frontend/floorplan-card.js`) is missing from its folder. Dashboards therefore cannot show the floor plan card.

Reinstall the floor plan card through HACS (HACS → Floor plan card → Redownload) and restart Home Assistant afterwards.

init.title: Song recognition
init.description: Optional: media devices that cannot report what they play (infrared) can have their song recognized through the microphone of a wall tablet. The tablet only sends an audio fingerprint, which is looked up at AcoustID. Get a free API key for your own application at {signup_url} and enter it here. Without a key, song recognition stays off.

data_description.acoustid_key: The key of your application at acoustid.org (not the user API key).
data_description.acoustid_url: Only for a self-hosted AcoustID server: its lookup URL. Empty = {lookup_url}

error.invalid_key: This does not look like an AcoustID API key.
error.invalid_url: The URL must start with https:// or http://.
